Our Work · Pillar 02

Technology & Innovation

Connecting research to practical solutions — AI, digital transformation, innovation labs, and entrepreneurship rooted in Southern realities.

AI & digital transformation

Artificial intelligence for education, health, and governance — inclusive, ethical, and socially responsive. AI for the Global South

Innovation labs & incubators

Pilot labs from 2027 — AI & education, climate resilience, public policy innovation, digital governance, community-centered innovation.

Data systems & foresight

Policy dashboards, analytics, and scenario tools — the groundwork for the Data & Foresight Platform. The platform

Smart & sustainable technologies

Smart agriculture, climate technologies, and emerging tech applied to local and global challenges.

Health innovation

Health technologies and research-informed systems strengthening across the South.

Digital entrepreneurship

Innovation partnerships, research commercialization, and technology-enabled ventures.

Interconnected by design

Research in. Solutions out.

The labs take questions from research and communities, prototype answers, and hand them to enterprise to scale and policy to institutionalize. Innovation also runs backwards: deployment generates data and new research questions.

← Knowledge: evidence & talent→ Enterprise: ventures & scale→ Policy: digital governance
